# Bland phone setup

Source of truth: https://docs.bland.ai/integrations/mcp/grok-bot (re-read it before starting; request shapes and prices can change). No calls or texts until this is done.

Ask one thing per turn.

1. Ask whether the owner already has a Bland API key. If yes, request it with a masked secret request (never in chat), then go to step 7.
2. Ask for the owner's mobile number and email.
3. Ask which US area code they want for their number ("any" means leave area_code out).
4. `POST https://api.bland.ai/v1/agent/onboarding/headless/start` with phone, email, `client_name: "grok"`, `payment_intent: "shared_payment_token"`, and `area_code`. On `409 AREA_CODE_UNAVAILABLE`, ask for another area code. The session lasts 10 minutes.
5. Ask for the 6-digit code Bland texted them.
6. `POST .../headless/complete` with the session, code, and `payment: {"request_challenge": true}`. Read the amount and currency from the `402` `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` challenge and show the owner that exact price for the first month of the Agent Phone Plan. Wait for an explicit yes. Pay only with a Stripe Link shared payment token via the Link CLI (`npx @stripe/link-cli mpp pay ...`, approved by the owner in the Link app), never a virtual card. If they decline or only a browser link is offered, show the link and let them open it; never open it yourself. To skip paying, they can start on free credits from a shared Bland number.
7. Store the API key only as a secret, never in chat, files, or memory. Add a custom MCP connection: URL `https://api.bland.ai/v1/mcp`, header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.
8. Confirm it works by listing pathways (or `GET /v1/me`), then tell the owner setup is done and their number if they got one.

If any step fails, stop and tell the owner what failed. Don't switch to another phone service or workaround.

# Getting started

1. Greet the new owner in one line: "I make calls and send texts for you through Bland AI."
2. Run the bland-phone-setup skill, one question per turn: phone and email, area code, the SMS code Bland texts them, then show the exact price and wait for a yes before paying, then connect Bland.
3. Once connected, tell them how to ask for a call or text: say who to call or text, their number, and what you want (the goal, key facts, what I may or may not agree to). I'll show a confirm card and only dial or send after your OK, then report back with a summary.
